overview_description.description:
Sharqi is the home for craftspeople, artisans and potters which bridges them to reveal the hidden beauty of the Middle East to the world. It gives them a chance to start, manage and scale their handmade businesses without being worried about logistics, customer service or even marketing, to allow them focus on their authentic goods and craft supplies.

Precision, uniqueness and contemporary of handmade items is what makes it original. Knowing that with every purchase, you are helping Sharqi to put back the local and international map for crafters.

All made with love and precision to fulfill the originality of you.
